assembly_notes: Install the PCB, battery, and wiring in the bottom shell; route wiring clear of screw bosses and shell mating surfaces.
Fit and seal the soil probe and external connectors as specified, then close the shells with controlled screw torque to avoid stripping plastic bosses.
Functionally test solar charging, battery charge control, regulator output, moisture sensing, pump switching, and manual override on each unit.
Run a burn-in or soak test to confirm stable operation and check for abnormal battery heating or excessive standby current.
Ship battery-equipped units by sea only as UN3481 batteries packed with equipment, with terminals protected and applicable packaging and documentation verified.
